## Checklist

- [ ] Verification follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/TalkBank/chatter/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
      [maintained check recipes](https://github.com/TalkBank/chatter/blob/main/book/src/contributing/dev-checks.md).
- [ ] Behavior changes include meaningful regression evidence at the affected
      boundary; documentation-only changes receive proportional checks.
- [ ] Generated artifacts, if affected, were regenerated through their owners.
- [ ] Docs updated (book and/or rustdoc) for any user-facing change.
- [ ] No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` added to long-lived code paths.
- [ ] The diff contains no private transcripts, credentials or operational data.
